requirements.title: Durable own grant, fixed selected sources, fencing and original deadlines
Root-bound bounded transfer, source rotation and receiving scratch custody
Owned historical authority, cross-view discovery, adoption and restart
Nonvoting learner revisions, exact image/receipt, slot retirement and cancellation
Actual joining owner initialization and process-loss recovery before voting
All seven profiles through INTENT, separate old/new majorities, FINAL and fresh BARRIER
Carried entry first, ACCEPT then PROOF, exact publication and steady round reuse
Competing native node owners, service barriers and recovery liveness
Departure fencing, original authority retirement and same-disk recovery
Combined real-owner peak resources and admitted completion headroom
Explicit phase-specific requirement mapping; no S/N acceptance inferred from counts
Independent original-first replay on exact source/build, portable evidence and failed-attempt retention

gaps.work: The focused 3-ADD learner pair and complete TCP lifetime/process matrices have source-bound capture, admission and hosted entries. Seven native carried/stable round histories now have source-bound local admission and an independent seven-job hosted entry. Four carried DATA phases now have a source-bound local entry with immutable payload, derived application state and next-BARRIER qualification; its four-member hosted adapter is prepared, with final-source execution pending. Two four-voter REMOVE carried INTENT/FINAL originals now have independent physical/lifecycle replay and 60 exact negatives, including portable optimized replay. Two new request-observed originals now add complete attempted transport, durable activation/slot replies and 153 exact network negatives per kind. Older response-only records are explicitly refused for this scope. The same originals now have temporal export authorization and complete-copy floor lifetime replay (416 transfers, 20 floors, 44 exact negatives). Continuous peer/future revision composition and complete observed retirement callbacks now add 154 exact negatives on those same originals. Two new originals now retain 1176 actual retirement file prefixes with 38 exact negatives and portable replay. The carried transition pair now has source/build/toolchain/reader-bound whole-history capture/admission and a two-job hosted execution/downloaded-replay entry requiring all 602 negative checks. Final-source execution, carried process-death histories and other profiles remain open. Continue other carried payload/process axes, competing owners, transition recovery and uncovered learner profiles. Phase 2 conditional process fixtures cannot substitute for Phase 3 native originals. Final-source execution remains pending; reuse existing producers/readers. Automatic competition, higher-ballot restart and the complete 48-case PROMISE reply-revocation matrix now have a three-group hosted adapter. All 50 original plans must share the seed and source/build/toolchain/reader, with complete downloaded original-first replay and exact shape-dependent negative vectors. Final-source execution and broader lifecycle/export coverage remain pending. The 32 joint-floor process histories now have a v2 local cohort gate and a hosted adapter with one immutable seed, whole native execution and independent downloaded replay. Their 1544 cut-specific negatives are fixed before mutation; complete final-source execution remains pending. The carried DATA v2 subset now includes eight whole-group carried DATA halt/SIGKILL methods in addition to the four original states. Each two-child history remains one execution/archive; all twelve require 587 exact negatives, with final-source execution still pending.
gaps.acceptance: Exact source/build/toolchain/reader-bound originals and independent original-first replay. Missing observations, unsupported histories or an original deadline failure remain failures. Whole ownership and revision histories stay indivisible.

gaps.work: Exercise physical simultaneous selected/current/inactive sources, learner staging and completion reservations under the frozen shared owner limits. Review actual lifetime overlap before adding a producer; existing accounting and conditional-prefix tests are prerequisites only. Nine native current/PROMISE and receiving-copy overlap histories now have independent physical accounting, exact/one-byte-short staging boundaries, retained failed-packet charges and post-refusal allocator force. They do not close the full metadata maximum, admitted FINAL/application completion or interrupted rotation obligations. A diagnostic with externally retained receiving copies failed at the seven-image floor-copy bound; establish normal-runtime reachability and legitimate joint quorum overlap before choosing an admission/lifetime correction. The diagnostic is not positive qualification. Subsequent native 5-REPLACE recovery now resumes its exact interrupted four-original floor over TCP and completes FINAL and the stable BARRIER on the same original directories. Independent whole-history storage, network, export, floor/source-retirement, continuous peer/learner/future and ballot replay now qualify that retained original. Its actual peak is seven images and five SOURCE slots; the separate partial-writer component covers six SOURCE slots. This does not close the simultaneous full maximum, native partial-body/process-death axes or final-source cohort. The sixteen native partial-body ordinal/cut histories now have an immutable capture entry and shared whole-history/ledger replay. Its execution and negative qualification are recorded separately from the conditional matrix; the complete native set, process-death cuts and phase-wide admission remain open. The v2 process producer now recovers the original incoming/outgoing scratch with the same journal budget. Independent replay derives interrupted/resumed writer and cold cleanup charges; the 32-case source-bound hosted entry is implemented. Transient acquisition/application-publication intervals, full simultaneous physical maximum, remaining native negative/torn-file axes and final-source execution remain open. A conditional-prefix storage continuation at the last admissible fixed-history operation now exercises same-directory INTENT/FINAL, stable BARRIER, next-RESERVE refusal and subsequent DATA. Its development JVM completed, but the original refusal receipt was invalid because it included a later read callback. The fixture recording boundary is corrected and the narrow unchanged-file replay passes; final complete producer execution and independent whole-history/resource qualification remain pending. The shared conditional capacity-completion producer now captures every voting/application/publication phase and both original-owner campaigns. Independent physical replay, exact typed image decoding, sixteen negative variants and portable replay pass for the operation-1 smoke only. Operation-231 full-boundary execution/replay remains pending; a smoke cannot satisfy that explicit profile. Historical prefix/learner authority, native process/network and combined peak resource qualification remain separate. The supplemental conditional capacity entry now captures one whole immutable-source execution and verifies exact source/build/toolchain/reader pins, JUnit and original inventory before complete physical/negative/portable replay. Its short pipeline check cannot qualify capacity or native history; final operation-231 execution and hosted seed attestation remain pending. The supplemental full-boundary hosted entry now freezes an independent seed, runs only the complete operation-231 method and downloads all original bytes for independent replay. It retains failed attempts and excludes smoke substitution. Hosted execution, original prefix authority and simultaneous maxima remain pending. Version-3 conditional continuation now requires complete original per-open resource journals and exact publication file/charge/checkpoint binding. The short profile passes 157 lifetimes and 165 physical publication boundaries with nine resource negatives. Full operation-231 execution, exact close intervals and simultaneous physical maxima remain open. Version-4 conditional continuation adds original close invocation/return checkpoints and reuses independent release-only interval replay for every observed budget. Nine close-specific negatives supplement the prior resource negatives; final-source full-boundary execution, broader physical shutdown order and simultaneous maxima remain open.
gaps.acceptance: Retain actual peak owner/lease/byte observations and independent physical replay at/over the bound, including admitted FINAL/recovery completion and stable DATA after membership exhaustion. Arithmetic alone does not qualify this obligation.

gaps.work: The exact source-selector audit now binds twenty candidate witnesses for all twelve Phase 3 requirements and pins the complete 486-archive catalogue. Complete Phase 3 schedule and rejection-family coverage still require original selectors, applicability and final-source replay; no coverage is inferred from substrings or counts. The frozen 3310 S rows remain Phase 5 requirements.
gaps.acceptance: No family closes from substring matches, aggregate pass counts or a related profile. Explicit refusal evidence for inapplicable rows, expected negative reasons and owner-phase boundaries must remain reviewable.

gaps.work: Implement final Phase 3 admission across all required subsets after the missing entries and precise coverage are known. Current per-workflow aggregates are scoped subset gates, not a phase-wide aggregate. An offline all-twelve seed gate now checks complete Git source, actual class inventories, portable tools, dependencies and each owning reader/run/attempt without requiring distinct reader sets to have the same hash. It returns PARTIAL with no runtime/workflow attestation. Original-history replay, precise coverage and final workflow attestation remain separate prerequisites. The offline history-cohort entry now reopens every declared raw artifact through the owning verifier and aggregate, with exact all-twelve seed reconciliation and input drift checks. Its PARTIAL receipt never attests workflow execution, frozen coverage or combined physical maxima. Development validation is synthetic orchestration/reader-contract testing; a complete actual final-source set has not been replayed. A read-only workflow observer now binds all twelve source workflows and 516 exact selected jobs/critical steps to the explicit run/attempt index, retaining all prior attempts and complete paginated jobs. The attested entry collects before and after original-first whole-history replay, refuses execution drift, and rechecks seeds/raw archives. Synthetic API/orchestration tests qualify the entry implementation only; actual workflow observations, missing resource/coverage obligations and failed-history review remain pending.
gaps.acceptance: Bind exact source and actual build/toolchain/readers, each workflow/run/attempt and complete declared inventories; reconcile independent seed provenance. Reject missing/failed/mixed originals. No acceptance from this planning report.

gaps.work: On separately authorized hosted execution, run every declared whole history on the final source, retain all attempts and fix reproducible failures before the closure audit.
gaps.acceptance: Successful independent original-first physical/history/network/resource replay and exact negatives for the final cohort. Historical successful component runs and synthetic orchestration tests cannot fill these slots.
